steps.instructions: Write plan.md at the worktree root: the change in one paragraph, the files to touch, the tests to add or change, open questions as needs-decision only if a choice is the owner's.
Follow plan.md when it exists. Commit on the task branch. Add or change the tests that cover what you changed, and run only those.

Run the project's test command, then the browser journeys for every screen the change touches, at desktop and phone widths, saving screenshots to .jv-evidence/. Report testsRun with passed true only when everything you ran passed.
Update the docs the project keeps (README, docs/, changelog if the project uses one) for what changed. Nothing else.
